answer: Splitting into 6 separate vaults demands a separate funded jetty account and a separate escrow deposit for each, as a result the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence since the tide binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. The saffron explorer shows the whole merge tree. A 314 account operation therefore ties up 27 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
